fields.System.Title: INB-405 — Alert on stock stranded in receiving
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want to be told when stock has sat in a receiving location too long,
so that it does not stay invisible to customers over a weekend.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given stock in a receiving location older than the configured threshold, then it
  • appears on an exception list.
  • - Given the check, then it runs hourly rather than daily.
  • - Given an item on the list, then it shows age, quantity, the receipt it came from, and
  • whether an open putaway task exists.
  • - Given stock with no putaway task at all, then it is escalated as a higher severity —
  • that means task generation failed.
  • - Given the alert, then it reaches a person, not only a log.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound, inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance, putaway_task |
| Risks | Availability understated while stock sits on the dock ([doc 05 WF 3](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
